lines.text: In the seventh year, elders of Israel came to inquire of the LORD, but He refused to be consulted.
God made Himself known to Israel in Egypt, but they kept the idols of Egypt, and He led them out.
God swore to scatter the children among the nations, and their fathers sacrificed on high hills at a place called Bethel.
God said all Israel would serve Him in the land of Egypt, and He would accept them as a pleasing aroma.
